description: Java source file defining the ConnectivityProxyActor class, which acts as an Akka actor to delegate Command and Signal objects within a cluster, specifically for connectivity services.

classes.name: ConnectivityProxyActor
classes.description: An Akka actor that handles delegation of commands and signals for connectivity service, forwarding specific command types to an aggregator actor and signals to a concierge forwarder.

methods.name: ConnectivityProxyActor
methods.description: Private constructor initializing the actor with a concierge forwarder, also creates the aggregator proxy actor.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Static method to create Props configuration for actor instantiation, taking the concierge forwarder ActorRef.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines message handling behavior: routing RetrieveThings commands to the aggregator actor, forwarding Signal objects to the concierge, and logging unexpected message types.
